subject: english
stem:
The school garden attracts bees and birds. Its trees give shade, and students grow vegetables there. Teachers also use the area for science lessons.
Which choice gives the central idea?
options: uses and benefits of the school garden
science lessons in the garden, but not any other use or benefit of it

optionRationales.reason: building a classroom：老師在花園上課，不是建教室。
uses and benefits of the school garden：動物、遮蔭、種菜與上課都呈現花園的多種價值。
只涵蓋最後一句的一項用途。
all wild animals：文章只提 garden 內兩類動物。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「能涵蓋多句的共同對象，而非只出現一次的細節」可推出 uses and benefits of the school garden；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 uses and benefits of the school garden 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
